mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS declines are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness indicator (UNRATE above 5.5%) signals reduced unemployment and stronger consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) indicates weakening supply conditions and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 240) signals persistent price pressures and potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240, or the Rank IC is above 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening job market and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where PAYEMS rises are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market boom (HOUST above 1000) signals strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding supply capacity and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO rises are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
